questions.stem: You have drawn the graph of $y = x^2 - 4x + 1$. To solve $x^2 - 4x + 1 = 3$ graphically, you should draw the line:
questions.explanation: Setting $x^2 - 4x + 1 = 3$ is equivalent to finding where $y = x^2 - 4x + 1$ meets $y = 3$. Draw the horizontal line $y = 3$ and read off the $x$-values at the intersection points.
